card.name: Hours in every-48-hours dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The word "hours" (or "day") right after "every 48", "every 36" or "every other" in dosing schedules, mostly for kidney-impairment dose adjustments.

modes.label: Extended interval in hours
modes.description: "hours" after "every 48" or "every 36" in renal dose tables.
modes.example: 4 mg/kg once every 48<< hours>>* 6 mg/kg once every

modes.label: Every other day
modes.description: "day" after "every other" in a dosing schedule.
modes.example: 50,000 units once every other<< day>> for at least 2 weeks after cultures
